input.rationale: Section 4 runs in our favour and meets the preferred position on its material terms. All work product prepared for Clear Capital under a SOW ("Works") is the property of Company (paid-for work), with Contractor obliged to give assistance and execute documents to perfect those rights (p0017-p0018). Contractor retains only its own pre-existing tools, methodologies and know-how not created for us (p0020), and grants us a perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use, copy, modify and create derivatives of any Contractor Information embedded in the Works for our business operations (p0021), plus an express right after payment to modify the software or engage third parties to do so without further fees (p0022). Nothing assigns or licenses Clear Capital IP or Clear Capital data to Contractor, and no joint ownership is created; § 5(b) expressly carves out programs, data and materials provided by Company from Contractor's granting rights. Minor sub-elements short of the ideal, noted but not flagged: there is no separate "Customer Data" ownership sentence (our data is instead protected as Confidential Information in § 8), ownership is expressed as vesting rather than a present assignment of copyright, further-assurance assistance is at our cost, and the licence-back is not labelled irrevocable or worldwide. These do not affect the substance of our ownership or exploitation rights, so no redline.
